attempts.summary: Deployed a rootless, boot-persistent nginx container on node1 as unprivileged user appsvc listening on port 8080, using an Ansible playbook run from node2 (the Ansible-equipped control node). Used podman Quadlet units plus subuid/subgid allocation and systemd user lingering so the service runs without any active login session. Completed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart protocol on both node1 and node2, with boot-id proof of restart and post-restart recovery for each.
